Source: 国际站询盘助手桌面版/reception_app, local working tree at 2026-11-06.
Copied only public Python source, not account/configuration/database/runtime files.
Upstream baseline commit: 399a35d (source includes existing uncommitted adapter fixes).

models.py, fact_rules.py, diagnostics.py, registration_fields.py:
  Pure contracts, conservative fact completeness and registration projections.
adapters/common.py, tool_signals.py, ai_runtime.py, desktop_query.py, feishu.py:
  Process boundary, durable side-effect ledger, tool signal checks, explicitly
  selected agent metadata, single request execution and optional Lark protocol.
  tool_signals.py additionally rejects structured tool_use/function_call blocks.
adapters/live.py:
  Extracted native identity/read/history/read-ready/seal/send/registration methods.
  Legacy AI prompt/planner, global polling, notification and retry entry points removed.
  Runtime authorization is supplied by the new NativeGateway override.

No runtime import refers to the original source directory. All dependencies are
Python standard library or files within this vendor package. Qt, controller,
storage, settings, databases, credentials and account records were not copied.
Own-account completion-record recovery is enabled only for the current supplied
account and the exact request nonce; no other-account or customer-task scanning.
Native AI uses 180s CLI / 190s process budgets, no tool approval.
2026-11-10 local desktop_query.py changes: optional per-call cancellation, bounded
child-tree termination and pipe draining for auxiliary read-only requests.
Desktop query uses owned_process.py for interruptible input and per-call process
ownership (a Windows job assigned while suspended, or a POSIX process group).
2026-11-10 local continuity changes: common.py/live.py permit a freshly authorized
automatic send attempt after an authoritative rejected/submission_started=False
receipt, preserving the old attempt and conversation-wide accepted/unknown fences.
System acknowledgement/final/verification continuations are implemented outside
this vendor package, with exact source/latest checks and accepted-ledger proof.
Local live.py preflight guards expose stable, sanitized codes for ready artifacts,
identity, sealing and source validation. Identity, latest-source and send fences
remain strict; the bounded historical card projection below is explicit.
2026-11-11 desktop_query.py retains the bounded _stop compatibility helper for
visual_query.py; text queries continue to use OwnedProcess. diagnostics.py carries
only explicitly allowed exception class names, never arbitrary exception messages,
customer content, ready artifacts or authorization values. Automatic retry limits
and legacy job-state recovery live in reception_service/send_retry_policy.py,
outside this vendor package; original native operations and receipts are retained.
2026-11-11 version 0.3.3: only recognized historical card renderings may use the
current canonical platform text in memory. Ready must also carry the native
[Card] marker or the same descriptor payload under a recognized card prefix;
unmarked unrelated prose and differing concrete product descriptors stay blocked.
The original 14-character Ready literal has not been recovered or inferred.
The current buyer source and ordinary prose remain strict; Ready files and sealed
tokens are never rewritten. Projected
cards require matching identity, role and time, and their canonical role/text/time
and empty attachments are rechecked using the existing post-seal history read.
Naive card clocks must agree with the verified source display clock at their
stated precision; no fixed merchant or host timezone is assumed. Unknown results,
conversation fences, source/version checks and retry limits remain unchanged.
